children: Overview
U.S. pet supplies retailer's Q2 revenue was flat yr/yr, meeting analyst expectations
Company posted second consecutive quarter of positive comparable sales growth
Petco prepaid $75 mln in debt after quarter-end and reaffirmed full-year sales and adjusted EBITDA outlook
Outlook
Petco reaffirms full-year 2026 net sales outlook of flat to up 1.5% year over year
Company expects full-year 2026 adjusted EBITDA of $415 mln to $430 mln
Petco sees Q3 2026 net sales growth of 0.4% to 1.0% and adjusted EBITDA of $100 mln to $103 mln
Result Drivers
TARIFF REFUNDS - Q2 results included a $6.8 mln net benefit from IEEPA tariff refunds after investments in new assortments and incremental fuel and tariff costs
MEMBERSHIP PROGRAM RELAUNCH - Co said sales were disrupted by stronger-than-expected points redemption after relaunch of membership program
CONSUMABLES GROWTH - Company said growth in consumables showed its turnaround strategy was gaining traction
